prompt: Generate 25 distinct tasks in school clubs and workshops. Batch 7/20.

tasks.topic: Robotics club assembled a prototype line-following robot and ran a successful hallway navigation test with taped routes
Environmental club organized a campus-wide tree inventory and compiled GPS-tagged data into a shared spreadsheet for review
Debate team drafted affirmative cases for upcoming regional tournament and conducted peer critiques in two mock rounds
Drama club finalized costume fittings for the spring play and labeled wardrobes with actors’ names and scene numbers
Chess club created a weekly ladder system and recorded initial match results to seed rankings for the month
Photography club curated a 20-photo exhibit theme shortlist and printed contact sheets for faculty advisor feedback
Coding club implemented user login and session persistence for a homework planner web app using a local test database
Literary magazine staff completed copyedits for prose submissions and flagged three pieces for sensitivity review
Science Olympiad team built a mousetrap-powered vehicle and measured baseline run distances on the gym track
Model United Nations club drafted position papers for two committees and scheduled a prep session on parliamentary procedure
Math club prepared solution write-ups for last week’s contest set and submitted them to the national portal
Culinary workshop tested a bread-baking lesson plan and documented oven temperature variations across school kitchens
Music production club recorded a demo track in the auditorium and exported stems for mixing practice sessions
3D printing workshop calibrated print beds on two machines and printed PLA test cubes to verify dimensional accuracy
Gardening club assembled raised beds and installed a drip irrigation timer connected to the greenhouse water line
Art club stretched new canvases and primed them with gesso, scheduling an acrylic techniques session next week
Astronomy club aligned the school telescope mount and captured stacked images of the Moon for astrophotography practice
Film club drafted a shooting script for a five-minute short and booked the media lab for weekend equipment checkout
Yearbook committee finalized the sports section layout and exported proofs for principal review and printer specs
Entrepreneurship club built a financial model for a snack kiosk and prepared a survey to gauge student demand
Board game design workshop created prototype card decks and ran a playtest to balance resource mechanics
Engineering club soldered components onto a PCB for a weather station and verified sensor readings via serial monitor
Language exchange club compiled a list of conversational prompts and paired members for weekly practice sessions
First aid club organized a CPR practice session and inspected training manikins for maintenance needs
Environmental chemistry workshop prepared calibration curves for nitrate testing kits and drafted a lab safety checklist
